description.p: A native COSMIC desktop reader for comic book archives (.cbz/.cbr), manga and comic series folders, and .epub books.

ul.li: Library view with covers, search, and a Continue Reading shelf
Scan whole library folders and group them automatically
Chapter-aware series folders with fast archive extraction
Single and dual page layouts, theater mode, fullscreen
Zoom and pan with trackpad or touchscreen pinch
Metadata and cover art from ComicVine and AniList

screenshot.caption: Your comics, manga, books and Jellyfin server in one library
Series pages with descriptions, release dates and progress
Books turn pages like an e-reader, one or two at a time
Choose the typeface, size, spacing and theme
Read comics and manga in theater mode, one page or two
Takes on your desktop's look, or a theme of your own

description.p: Fixes the comic reader's chapter list and error messages showing through to the desktop in theater mode when the window isn't maximized.

ul.li: Colour themes: built-in themes, plus your own COSMIC theme (.ron) and KDE colour scheme (.colors) files
Follows your system's dark mode and accent colour while running, on every desktop; on Windows with the same accent shades as Windows' own apps
Series show their creators and years, issues their release dates, and books their author
The mouse wheel zooms comic pages directly; hold Shift for finer steps
Two-page spreads show on their own, and each zoomed page starts at its top
Full screen hides the header bar until the pointer reaches the top
Jellyfin: what you're reading shows on the server's dashboard
Libraries on unplugged drives are kept, never deleted
An About section with an update check

description.p: Store listing update: Nebula Reader now appears under "Made for COSMIC" in the COSMIC Store, and the project moved to github.com/NotTimm/NebulaReader.

ul.li: Windows: the app now starts on PCs without the Visual C++ runtime installed
Jellyfin: the reader's title bar shows the server, whether it's online, and whether your progress has saved
Jellyfin: progress is saved once you settle on a page instead of on every page turn, and book positions sync too
Jellyfin: reading no longer fills the server's activity log with download entries
Local comics and books show their file path when you hover over "Local" in the title bar
First macOS build for Apple Silicon

description.p: The first stable release, under a new name: Cosmic Comic is now Nebula Reader.

ul.li: Comics, manga and EPUB books in one library, with covers, progress and a Continue Reading shelf
Books turn pages like an e-reader, one page or two side by side, with click-to-zoom images
Jellyfin libraries: Quick Connect sign-in, streamed pages, progress synced both ways
Runs on COSMIC, KDE Plasma, GNOME and Windows, taking on each desktop's look
Libraries and settings from Cosmic Comic carry over automatically

description.p: Jellyfin, and books that turn pages.

ul.li: Read comic and book libraries from a Jellyfin server: Quick Connect sign-in, pages streamed as you read, progress synced both ways
All / Local / Jellyfin switch in the library when you have both
Books turn pages like an e-reader, one page or two side by side; scrolling is still an option
Book images fit the page, and clicking one opens it to zoom and pan
Hover hints on every reader button; full screen is a single toggle
Button roundness setting outside COSMIC, and cleaner manga-tui chapter names

description.p: A new icon, and a Windows installer.

ul.li: New galaxy book app icon, on every platform
Windows: per-user installer with Start menu entry and "Open with" for comics and books, and the icon embedded in the exe

description.p: Runs on Windows, and takes on the look of the desktop it runs on.

ul.li: Native look on KDE Plasma (Breeze colours from your colour scheme), Windows 11 and GNOME, selectable under Settings, Appearance, Style
Native title bar on KDE and Windows
Windows build, plus AppImage and Flatpak packages
